items.desc: A first solo trek along the famous high-altitude trail becomes a journey of quiet discoveries.

items.title: Banking stocks show resilience as Nepse struggles to recover
items.desc: The banking index has maintained a bullish moving-average pattern even as Nepse remains in a longer-term bearish trend. But resistance around 1,600 continues to hold back the sector.

items.title: Home minister pins rank insignia on new police chief
items.desc: Sudhan Gurung breaks with convention by personally conferring the insignia on Manoj KC, who previously led investigations into the fake Bhutanese refugee scam.

items.title: Key takeaways from Democrats’ sweeping victory in US midterm elections
items.desc: Democrats capture both chambers of Congress in a sharp rebuke to Trump, with historic gains in Republican strongholds, voter anger over living costs and losses for the president’s handpicked candidates.

items.title: The reason IGP Dan Bahadur Karki was sacked
items.desc: Officials say the Inam Sapkota probe, resistance to arrest orders and a long-standing preference for another officer led to the removal.

items.title: Obama urges Democrats to act after sweeping election gains
items.desc: The former president says voters have sent a clear message against divisive politics as projections show Democrats poised to take control of both chambers of Congress.

items.title: Removed police chief seeks legal advice
items.desc: Dan Bahadur Karki, who had 17 months left in his tenure as inspector general, is considering legal action after the cabinet replaced him with Manoj KC.

items.title: Vikram Misri says India ready to help rebuild Nepal’s flood-hit infrastructure
items.desc: New Delhi is prepared to consider Nepal’s proposals for assistance and reconstruction projects following the Bhotekoshi flood.

items.title: Out as IGP, in as adviser: Nepal has seen this before
items.desc: The RSP-led government’s decision to remove IGP Dan Bahadur Karki recalls a similar move in 1997, when Home Minister Bamdev Gautam replaced IGP Achyut Krishna Kharel.

items.title: Who is Manoj KC, the officer now leading Nepal Police?
items.desc: A contemporary of Dan Bahadur Karki in the same police batch, KC rose to prominence for leading the investigation into the fake Bhutanese refugee scam but was later sidelined.

items.title: No action taken against IGP Karki, only responsibilities reshuffled: Government spokesperson Pokharel
items.desc: Government spokesperson Sasmit Pokharel says a new post has been created to strengthen security in the current circumstances, and urges that the decision not be viewed as punitive.

items.title: BREAKING: Government removes IGP Dan Bahadur Karki from post
items.desc: The Cabinet on Wednesday has appointed Karki as the prime minister’s security adviser and assigned new responsibilities to Additional Inspector General Manoj KC, a minister says.

items.title: South Africa’s David Miller arrives to join Karnali Yaks
items.desc: The experienced left-handed batter is expected to make his Nepal Premier League debut against Sudurpaschim Royals on Friday, adding firepower to a Karnali side that has won two of its first three matches.

items.title: Misri meets Khanal, discusses Nepal-India ties
items.desc: The two discussed ways to deepen the multifaceted partnership and strengthen longstanding ties of friendship between Nepal and India, according to the foreign ministry.

items.title: The German who helped take Ilam tea to Europe gets a fond farewell
items.desc: Thomas Holz built more than a business relationship with Nepal’s tea growers. After years of helping introduce their produce to European markets, he has retired from his job but says his bond with the farmers will endure.

items.title: A butterfly haven on Kathmandu’s doorstep
items.desc: Home to 124 of Nepal’s approximately 630 butterfly species, Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park offers a rich mix of biodiversity, forest trails and tranquil escapes from the bustle of the capital.

items.title: India puts food before fuel as El Niño dents ethanol ambitions
items.desc: Poor monsoon rains and rising food prices are threatening feedstock supplies, potentially pushing ethanol blending down to 15 percent and increasing India’s reliance on imported oil.

items.title: Two dead in Bajhang jeep crash
items.desc: The jeep, carrying an estimated 12 to 15 passengers, crashed in Kedarsyu Rural Municipality on Wednesday morning. Police have been deployed to the scene.

items.title: Indian Foreign Secretary Misri arrives in Kathmandu ahead of Shah’s India visit
items.desc: Talks with Nepali officials will cover a proposed economic package, Indian-funded projects and preparations for the prime minister’s visit to New Delhi.

items.title: Floods push back Siddhababa tunnel opening to mid-January
items.desc: The Bhotekoshi and Kaligandaki floods disrupted the delivery of electrical and safety equipment, delaying plans to open the tunnel to traffic.

items.title: Top takeaways from the US midterm elections
items.desc: Exit polls point to widespread voter discontent over the cost of living and declining Republican support among several key groups that helped Trump win the 2024 presidential election.

items.title: Man critically injured in shooting in Rautahat
items.desc: The 28-year-old was hit by six bullets in an attack in Gaur Municipality on Tuesday night. Police have yet to identify the assailants or establish a motive.

items.title: Democrats gain ground in battle for Congress with North Carolina flip
items.desc: Roy Cooper’s victory in North Carolina and Democratic gains in Georgia and New Hampshire strengthen the party’s bid to regain control of Congress, as voter discontent over Trump’s economic policies and the Iran war weighs on Republicans.

items.title: Kathmandu Film Festival puts Nepali cinema’s past, present and future in focus
items.desc: The festival screened new titles and restored classics, and brought together filmmakers to discuss the industry’s evolution and creative challenges.

items.title: NPL Season 3 offers a promising platform for emerging Bangladeshi talent
items.desc: Ten Bangladeshi players are playing for five different franchises. The list runs from experienced Shakib Al Hasan to young prospects like Ariful Islam and Jishan Alam.

items.title: Andre Russell extends his stay for an extra match and vows to return next season
items.desc: The West Indies allrounder scored 52 and took four wickets in Biratnagar’s two-run win over Janakpur, extending his stay by a match and promising to return for next season’s NPL.

items.title: Win back Indian travellers
items.desc: October’s sharp drop in Indian arrivals exposes Nepal’s tourism industry’s vulnerability.

items.title: When fear, favour and fervour drive the system
items.desc: Both the judiciary and the press reflect the prejudices, hierarchies and contradictions of the milieu they inhabit.
